option_1_translation.note: Standard UAE trade-name construction (X for Y). Reads naturally to an Arabic speaker and is self-describing, which helps Arabic local search.

option_2_transliteration.means: phonetic rendering of the English name; carries no meaning in Arabic
option_2_transliteration.note: Matches the English brand sound exactly. Preferred if the brand is marketed in English and you want one spoken name.

option_3_hybrid.means: Emirates for Electric Scooters, keeping 'Emirates' transliterated
option_3_hybrid.note: Keeps brand recognition while staying descriptive.

ar_options_considered.recommendation_reasoning: Google matches Arabic queries semantically, so a descriptive Arabic name ('electric scooters') earns relevance for Arabic searches like 'سكوتر كهربائي دبي' that a pure transliteration cannot. It is also the conventional form for a UAE retail trade name.
risks_to_check_before_filing: UAE trade-name rules restrict names of countries/emirates. 'الإمارات' may require approval or be refused by DED. Verify with the licensing authority.
'Emirates' is a heavily used mark in the UAE (Emirates airline group). Confirm there is no objection for this activity.
Confirm the Arabic name on the existing trade licence first - if one exists, use it verbatim and discard these options.

no_trade_licence.impact: Blocks Google Business Profile verification (Google asks for business documentation), Google Merchant Center, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, and business profiles on Trustpilot/Dubizzle. Separately, trading commercially in the UAE without a licence is not permitted regardless of what Google requires.
no_trade_licence.action: Owner to obtain an appropriate UAE e-commerce/trader licence, or accept that local-listing channels stay closed.

no_verification_address.owner_statement: Prefers not to use a real address for verification.
no_verification_address.impact: Google requires a real address for verification even when it is hidden from the public listing. PO boxes and virtual offices are explicitly disallowed and cause suspension. There is no compliant workaround. Without an address, GBP verification cannot complete.
no_verification_address.mitigation: For a service-area business the address is NEVER displayed publicly - only used to verify. That already addresses the privacy concern.
